notes: The candidate p99 gates passed despite 41 individual macOS callback deadline misses. Successful CI does not mean all callbacks met their deadlines.
The existing workflow executes baseline, candidate, and legacy aggregate profile sequentially. This is not the new independent ABBA/BAAB instrumentation-overhead experiment.
The fixed baseline has 36 routes and three tests; the candidate has 66 routes and five tests. This reference is not the released 7b20cd9d1f90e3e2969c250712b199e893cf50cd frozen gate.
Candidate and legacy profile populations remain separate. No timing distribution is pooled across operating systems or measurement modes.
Windows thread cycles remain cycles; unavailable thread CPU duration is not zero and is not inferred from cycle counts.
Archive and internal-file integrity were independently checked. CI receipt gate summaries and its existing raw verifier results were reviewed; no local full CSV semantic revalidation was performed.
These console targets do not exercise real plugin-host or audio-device callbacks.
